metadata.definition: Each point is one distinct selection history. All configuration IDs and full-precision saved metrics are retained; equivalent configurations share one point.
metadata.frontier_definition: Among rules filling at least 95% of 20 places on average: maximize later participation and distinct names per year; minimize puzzles after debut. Highlight the full three-goal frontier in both projections.
metadata.reach_definition: Expected distinct displayed names, annualized over 98 calendar months. Independent selection within boundary ties.
metadata.scope: Descriptive pooled historical study. Export of saved results only; no new scoring or selection is performed.
